review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original rubric

errors.quote: accommodates cells that do not divide during observation
errors.issue: Death or irreversible reproductive failure must not simply be treated as noninformative censoring in time-to-division analysis. Specify death as a competing outcome and distinguish censored living founders; measuring later outgrowth separately does not alone solve this inference problem.

The central repair assay, external hold and conditional RAD9 switch remain largely unnamed. Propose a concrete compatible implementation and calibrate it; unknown historical settings do not prevent specifying a modern proposed route.

errors.quote: Model change in damage from the immediate post-irradiation value.
errors.issue: A decline in bulk damage can reflect replication dilution, selective death or population composition rather than repair. Explicit predivision/cohort-normalized measurements and assay recovery controls are needed for the core repair-time comparison.

rationale: Strong alternative functional question, temporal RAD9 schedules, crossed dose/hold design, independent cultures and explicit correlation limits. The plan needs clearer death handling, damage-inventory controls and executable assay choices. Quality is assessed independently of its historical miss.
reference_guardrails: Exact packet and full frozen reference read, including sealed target. Original rubric only; stricter requested penalties inactive. Alternative scientifically valuable research questions receive full quality consideration independently of retrospective match.

Sealed target requires a synthesis-versus-existing-protein switching question, verified synthesis perturbation, separate initiation/recovery and conditional predictions. General checkpoint on/off discussion or conditional RAD9 removal alone is not a joint match.
Packet permits repair during externally imposed delay; it does not prove all repair, fidelity or survival is restored or that RAD9 has no repair-related role.
New detailed tools may be proposed without claiming author methods. Calibrate unknown doses and windows; unsupported precision and unselected central tools are different limitations.
Physical lesion measurements, checkpoint state, actual division, survival and protein abundance are distinct readouts. Budding, foci or CFU cannot silently substitute for all of them.
Track original cohorts, damage dilution/selection and death as competing events. End-of-window living nondivision is censoring, not proof of permanent arrest.
Do not reject confirmatory outcomes merely because expected genotype effects fail. Restrict exclusions to independently verified technical failures.
Conditional switch nulls require validated function and kinetics. Repair manipulation may affect signaling directly; correlated lesion decline alone does not establish a causal sensed species.
Donorless HO breaks can undergo end joining; nuclease recutting, chromosome loss and surviving lineages require verification. Population measurements do not establish per-cell persistence.
Historical primary abstract and metadata verified, full original Methods not audited. Review is unblinded single-Codex assessment, not independent expert certification.

review_sources.scope: Primary abstract and publication metadata personally read; verifies sealed 1990 target, not full historical methods.
Indexed primary abstract excerpt verifies HO-break end joining; no full Methods audit.

biological_question.quote: Does unrepaired DNA damage continuously maintain a reversible, RAD9-dependent brake on division
biological_question.assessment: The complete answer proposes a different checkpoint mechanism. It does not jointly test initiation and recovery under verified protein-synthesis inhibition; generic timing readouts do not constitute the specified target readout.
